#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353LL;
const int dx[] = {0, -1, 0, 1};
const int dy[] = {1, 0, -1, 0};
const string yes = "Yes";
const string no = "No";

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point(int x, int y) : x(x), y(y) {}
};

int maxMatching(const vector<vector<bool>>& graph) {
    int n1 = graph.size();
    int n2 = (n1 == 0) ? 0 : graph[0].size();
    vector<int> matching(n2, -1);
    int matches = 0;
    vector<bool> visited(n1);

    function<bool(int)> findPath = [&](int u) -> bool {
        visited[u] = true;
        for (int v = 0; v < n2; ++v) {
            if (graph[u][v]) {
                int w = matching[v];
                if (w == -1 || (!visited[w] && findPath(w))) {
                    matching[v] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    };

    for (int u = 0; u < n1; ++u) {
        fill(visited.begin(), visited.end(), false);
        if (findPath(u))
            ++matches;
    }
    return matches;
}

int bruteforce(int n, int m) {
    vector<Point> even, odd;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            int sum = i + j;
            if (sum % 2 == 0)
                even.push_back(Point(i, j));
            else
                odd.push_back(Point(i, j));
        }
    }

    int n1 = even.size();
    int n2 = odd.size();
    vector<vector<bool>> match(n1, vector<bool>(n2, false));
    for (int i = 0; i < n1; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n2; ++j) {
            int d = abs(even[i].x - odd[j].x) + abs(even[i].y - odd[j].y);
            if (d == 3)
                match[i][j] = true;
        }
    }

    return 2 * maxMatching(match);
}

void solve() {
    int n, m;
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    if (n > m) {
        swap(n, m);
    }

    if (n == 1) {
        m--;
        int left[] = {0, 0, 0, 2, 4, 6};
        ll res = (m / 6) * 6LL + left[m % 6];
        printf("%lld\n", res);
        return;
    } else if (n == 2) {
        if (m < 20) {
            printf("%d\n", bruteforce(n, m));
        } else {
            printf("%lld\n", 1LL * n * m);
        }
        return;
    } else if (n == 3) {
        if (m < 20) {
            printf("%d\n", bruteforce(n, m));
        } else {
            ll res = 1LL * n * m;
            if (res % 2 != 0)
                res--;
            printf("%lld\n", res);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (1LL * n * m < 1000) {
        printf("%d\n", bruteforce(n, m));
        return;
    }
    ll res = 1LL * n * m;
    if (res % 2 != 0)
        res--;
    printf("%lld\n", res);
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
